collection.title: Audi Q3 2011 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a the Audi Q3 2011 - 2018 which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this Q3 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
